'''Wen Gallo''' was a [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was a [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] of the [[Manaan Special Warfare Group]]. Around [[3626 BBY]] when the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] [[Invasion of Manaan|invaded]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] she was a leader of the Selkath resistance that provided aid to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When the [[Alliance Commander|leader of]] [[Task Force Nova]] arrived on the planet she helped them disable the [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]].

==Biography==
Founding member and current field leader of the Manaan Special Warfare Group (MSWG). Gallo distinguished herself early in her service career during the [[Battle of Gwaria Trench]] by refusing to retreat after her company suffered significant losses to kolto raiders. Marshaling the remaining soldiers, her group slowed the enemy advance with guerilla tactics until a proper response could be mustered. The incident would later be cited as the final push needed to form the MSWG.<ref name="CX">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Colonel Wen Gallo}}</ref>

===Invasion of Manaan===
During the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Invasion of Manaan|invasion]] of [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] Gallo joined forces with the Republic to prevent the Empire from taking [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]].
When she boarded one of the imperial ships she was nearly killed by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Cadmael Benthos Dosk]] who vented out the oxygen from the room she was in. Shortly after [[Alliance Commander|leader of]] [[Task Force Nova]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Arn Peralun]] who sabotaged the ship arrived and found her unconcious. They used the escape pods to get her to safety, but also leaving the kolto in the falling ship.<ref name="Legacy">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Gallo is known across Manaan as a hero, loyalist, and an uncompromising advocate of her people. Far from a diplomat, her time as leader of the MSWG has only hardened her suspicions towards offworlders and has resulted in the occasional interplanetary incident due to her candor. Gallo has refused several promotions, preferring to remain in the field to personally oversee operations.<ref name="CX">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Colonel Wen Gallo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Wen Gallo appears in the Republic storyline of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', voiced by [[Jan Johns]].<ref>''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'' {{c|credits}}</ref>

==Gamemplay alternatives==
The player can choose a dark side option to let Gallo die in the falling ship and use the escape pods to save kolto.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Out of the Blue|[[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]}}</ref>
